logs.nginx-unit:
# /etc/systemd/system/nginx.service
[Unit]
Description=BliKVM loopback HTTPS Web UI
Wants=kvmd.service
After=kvmd.service
ConditionPathExists=/etc/kvmd/nginx/ssl/server.key
ConditionPathExists=/etc/kvmd/htpasswd

[Service]
Type=exec
ExecStartPre=/usr/sbin/nginx -t -c /etc/kvmd/nginx/nginx.conf
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/nginx -c /etc/kvmd/nginx/nginx.conf -g 'daemon off;'
ExecReload=/bin/kill -HUP $MAINPID
KillSignal=SIGQUIT
TimeoutStopSec=10
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ReadWritePaths=/run /var/log/nginx /var/lib/nginx
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

# /etc/systemd/system/nginx.service.d/access.conf
[Unit]
Requires=blikvm-access.service
After=blikvm-access.service network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
# Fail closed if the table disappeared while nginx was stopped.
ExecStartPre=/usr/sbin/nft list table ip blikvm_lab
# nft startup verification needs Netlink; inherited AF_UNIX/AF_INET remain.
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_NETLINK
logs.kvmd-unit:
# /usr/lib/systemd/system/kvmd.service
[Unit]
Description=BliKVM video-only kvmd
BindsTo=dev-kvmd\x2dvideo.device
After=dev-kvmd\x2dvideo.device
Conflicts=ustreamer.service

[Service]
Type=exec
User=kvmd
Group=ustreamer
RuntimeDirectory=kvmd/api kvmd/ustreamer
RuntimeDirectoryMode=0750
ExecStart=/usr/bin/kvmd --run
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2
TimeoutStopSec=15
KillMode=mixed
UMask=0007
Environment=PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX
CapabilityBoundingSet=
DevicePolicy=closed
DeviceAllow=/dev/kvmd-video rw

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

# /usr/lib/systemd/system/kvmd.service.d/hid.conf
[Unit]
Requires=blikvm-gadget.service
After=blikvm-gadget.service

[Service]
DeviceAllow=/dev/kvmd-hid-keyboard rw
DeviceAllow=/dev/kvmd-hid-absolute w
DeviceAllow=/dev/kvmd-hid-relative w

# /usr/lib/systemd/system/kvmd.service.d/web.conf
[Service]
# Preserve kvmd/ustreamer UID, primary group, modes and device permissions.
# Only the two socket directories grant the nginx worker traversal/access.
ExecStartPre=+/usr/bin/setfacl -m u:www-data:--x /run/kvmd
ExecStartPre=+/usr/bin/setfacl -m u:www-data:r-x,d:u:www-data:rwX /run/kvmd/api /run/kvmd/ustreamer

[Unit]
